name: Ossified Undead
background:
The Ossified Undead are creatures of bone and magic in human shape. Their legions march slowly and with terrible purpose, cutting down any who oppose them. 

The Ossified Undead destroyed all life in their Plane in order to escape the influence of a mighty Plague Daemon, preserving their people as deathless constructs. When they discovered Tyria, they hoped to escape their lifeless plane, but were betrayed and banished back to their home. However, the Great Rift opened new portals to Tyria again, and now they are determined to avenge their betrayal and claim their new home by force.
backgroundFull:
The native plane of the Ossified Undead was a verdant and tranquil place until the eye of the Plague God fell upon it. Under the malign influence of Plague, the world began to rot and wither. As the world around them fell into decay, the remaining Sages gathered to make a plan: they studied strange and dark magic that would allow them to transcend the weaknesses of flesh that the Havoc God preyed upon, and they would become beings of bone and spirit beyond death. Some rejected this, but many more were desperate enough to embrace the idea and become the Ossified Undead. 

While those who rejected the Sages died out to disease and corruption, the Ossified Undead began to purge their lands of life. They drove back the Plague God’s servants until their plane was saved, but no living thing remained. After this, the Ossified Undead lived in peace for a time. None are certain how long this was, as without life, time soon lost any meaning. Some fell into insanity or despair. The Sages were once more charged with seeking a solution.

The Sages’ hopes were lifted when they discovered a Voidgate created by a strange sage from the plane of Tyria, who begged for help to protect his people. After some discussion, the Sages agreed to offer their knowledge, and in exchange, they asked for the right to settle in Tyria. While they provided their knowledge willingly, the Tyrians betrayed their side of the deal and severed their link with the Ossified Undead plane once the Havoc Wars were over. 

The Ossified Undead and their Sages tried to reopen the link many times without success. Their opportunity only came when the Rift devastated Tyria, and they could take advantage of the sudden surge of energy that created the rift in order to open previously lost Voidgates throughout Tyria. 

The Ossified Undead have begun to enter Tyria, returning once more to a land of life, but now view other factions with distrust, remembering their previous betrayal. Yet they are determined to make their home for their people in Tyria, even if they have to fight every other faction in Tyria to do it. 

How will you carve out a new home in this plane of life?

specialRules.name: Infiltrate
specialRules.description: Counts as having Ambush, but may be deployed anywhere over 3" away from enemy unit.

specialRules.name: No Retreat Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get No Retreat. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Sergeant
specialRules.description: This model gets AP(+1) when attacking.

specialRules.name: Defense
specialRules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

specialRules.name: Bane when Shooting
specialRules.description: This model gets Bane when shooting.

specialRules.name: Evasive Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Evasive. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Swift Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Swift. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Relentless Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Relentless. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Regeneration Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Regeneration. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Bane in Melee Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Bane in melee. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Ossified
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have Ossified, hits they take count as having AP(-2) from Ossified (instead of only AP(-1)).

specialRules.name: Entrenched
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have this rule, as long as they haven't moved during this round, enemy units shooting at them from over 12” away get -1 to hit rolls.

specialRules.name: Ossified
specialRules.description: When units where most models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).

specialRules.name: Precision Feat
specialRules.description: Once per game, when this unit attacks, you may use this rule so that all models with this rule in it get +1 to hit rolls.

specialRules.name: Shatter
specialRules.description: For each unmodified result of 6 to hit, those hits get AP(+3).

specialRules.name: Spell Accumulator
specialRules.description: Gets X accumulator tokens at the start of each round, but can’t hold more than 6 tokens at once. Casters from other friendly units within 12" may spend this model's accumulator tokens as if they were their own spell tokens. Friendly casters may only use this rule if this unit isn't Shaken.

specialRules.name: Unpredictable Fighter
specialRules.description: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

specialRules.name: Swift
specialRules.description: This model may ignore the Slow rule.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Ossified Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Enhanced Ossified. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Regeneration Buff
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 nearest friendly units within 12", which gets Regeneration once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Furious Mark
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Furious against once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Enhanced Fortified
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have Fortified, hits they take count as having AP(-2) from Fortified (instead of only AP(-1)).

specialRules.name: Fortified
specialRules.description: When units where most models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).

specialRules.name: Ambush
specialRules.description: Only deploys D3 rounds afters its wave, and at the start of the round it's placed within 6” of a random AI Goal.

specialRules.name: No Retreat
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule fails a morale test that causes it to be Shaken or Routed, the test counts as passed instead. Then, roll as many dice as the number of wounds it would take to fully destroy it, and for each result of 1-3 the unit takes one wound, which can't be ignored.

specialRules.name: AP
specialRules.description: Targets get -X to Defense rolls when blocking hits.

specialRules.name: Bane
specialRules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and when attacking, the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6.

specialRules.name: Evasive
specialRules.description: Enemies get -1 to hit rolls when attacking units where most models have this rule.

specialRules.name: Relentless
specialRules.description: When this model shoots at enemies over 9” away, unmodified result of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

specialRules.name: Regeneration
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

specialRules.name: Caster
specialRules.description: Follows same rules as heroes, picking one random spell to cast, and spending all tokens to cast it when activated. If the chosen spell can’t be cast for any reason, then the model doesn’t cast.

specialRules.name: Slow
specialRules.description: Moves -2” when using Advance, and -4” when using Rush/Charge.

specialRules.name: Furious
specialRules.description: When charging, unmodified result of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

specialRules.name: Unstoppable
specialRules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and ignores all negative modifiers to this weapon which are not from this model's special rules.
